title: Confidence isn't loud, here's how to find your voice | Nimi Mehta
description:
⭐ NEWSLETTER - https://thebalancetheory.com

Today I am joined by a new friend, and amazing woman - Nimi Mehta! 

Today we chat about the misconceptions about confidence, can it be soft? PLUS how to find your voice to embrace that confidence. She shares her “Voice Layer Theory”, how she took a leap, how she has struggled always being “nice” and utilised that to become assertive + a really beautiful self care practice you can try. There’s so much in this one, I know you’ll love it!

WHO AM I?
I’m Erika, an Australian living in Dubai, a mum and the creator and host of this podcast. After almost a decade in law, I’ve stepped into a new chapter centred on what I love - helping people design and implement the architecture they need to live their dream life. As someone with big ambitions, I’m passionate about pursuing what matters and to do so, we need to create our own lives intentionally. This channel is a space for honest conversations, curiosity and practical tools to support that journey. Welcome - I’m glad you’re here.
